Allows the user to manage (add, remove) dropdowns and dropdown bodies.
This adds a new key/playlist.
This removes the selected key/playlist.
This hides the add/remove dropdown.
Simply saves all changes made to disk.
[[[warning:Note:]]] Upon changes, the button colour is set to [[[strong:red]]] to remind the user to click it.
Key holds the name and data of a playlist or list of URLs.
Enabled: The key is active, so its playlists and URLs are downloaded.
Disabled: The whole key (section) is turned off, so any URLs or playlists inside it will not be downloaded.
This is the executable for helping with the download process.
[[[warning:Note:]]] This field is no longer needed but is here for flexibility in the future.
This is the codec the songs will be saved as.

rows: The best quality, with larger files

contents.Text: For the full list of codecs, and what lossy, lossless and containers mean, see the [[[button:Codecs][/_Guides/Codecs]]] guide.
These are customisable arguments on how you want to download.
This is a very advanced subject, so for normal users starting from zero, top to bottom, use [[[strong:option 1]]] (with thumbnails) or [[[strong:option 3]]] (without thumbnails).
For those advanced users who want to customise or understand these in depth, here is the page for that: [[[button:Advanced args page][YT_dlp_args]]].

RhythmiRust adds a few extra arguments on top of yt-dlp ([[[strong:download_dir]]], [[[strong:target_url]]], [[[strong:codec]]], [[[strong:ffmpeg_path]]], [[[strong:deno_path]]] and [[[strong:PATH_SEPARATOR]]]). They are explained in the [[[button:Advanced Settings][/Main Window/Settings/Config/Advanced Settings]]] page.
This holds the list of URLs/keys.
This is a key/URL where you save information into.

rows: What the playlist folder will be called in the download folder
Where you add the URLs you want to download into that folder

contents.Text: [[[strong:Folder names:]]] If you input a name of "playlist/hi", it will make a directory called "playlist", then inside make a directory called "hi", then download into "hi".
[[[strong:Saving:]]] Hit "save" once you are done, then "save changes" to finalise them.
[[[warning:Tip:]]] As of version [[[strong:0.4.0]]], you can use these URLs, and they will download all of that user's public playlists:
•https://soundcloud.com/username/sets
•https://www.youtube.com/@username/playlists
SoundCloud likes work too:
•https://soundcloud.com/username/likes
The program tries to handle playlists generically: it detects them, then sorts them into a multithreaded download, in batches, like it does for all normal playlists.
[[[italics:Before, it was able to download from these URLs but it was only single-threaded.]]]
